# Security Policy

If you find a security problem in Shoald, please tell us privately
so we can fix it before anyone else can use it.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Email **security@shoald.com**.
Please don't open a public issue, pull request, or discussion about it.

Include as much of this as you can:

- What the problem is and what someone could do with it
- Steps to reproduce it
- Which part is affected (player, edge, cloud, panel, or website) and its version
- Any proof-of-concept code, logs, or screenshots

## What happens next

1. We confirm we got your report within 3 working days.
2. We look into it and tell you whether we can reproduce it.
3. We fix it and let you know when the fix is out.

We'll keep you updated along the way.
If you'd like credit when the fix is announced, tell us the name to use.

## Disclosure

Please give us a reasonable time to fix the problem before sharing it publicly.
We'll agree on a date with you.

## Supported versions

Shoald is in early development. Only the latest version gets security fixes.
